_meta.title: Private Floor Club verification benchmark - batch 9 cases
_meta.groundTruthNote: Batch 9 regression fixtures. B9R04 is a self-named firm: the person's name on the firm's own site and on /in/joshuasteinnyc counts as the person and stays self-reported. A different Joshua Stein and 'Attorney Mark Joshua Stein' stay non-corroborating. B9R02 types the brand JLL and jll.com, so JLL is the company, not a review-only alias; ticker JLL is Jones Lang LaSalle Inc, CIK 1037976, only because the domain stem matches. B9R01 and B9R02 expect a Form 3/4/5 reporting-owner hit once the CIK is known (Ready Capital CIK 1527590, Capasse Thomas E; JLL CIK 1037976, Ulbrich Christian). A CourtListener no-record is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS. B9F01 is an unregistered domain and must not receive company-exists credit. LR01-LR03 are a made-up person at a real company: company confirmed, person not confirmed, not a rejection. Emails are Gmail. Nothing is sent.

defaults.statement: I work in commercial real estate and would like to meet other owners and operators.

_meta.emailPolicy: Every case uses a Gmail address so the email domain carries no signal. Nothing is ever sent to these addresses.
